name: Cuneiform
notes: Proto-cuneiform (Uruk IV, c. 3350-3200 BCE) is administrative/economic proto-writing, not yet a full phonetic system; mature logo-syllabic cuneiform capable of recording continuous language develops over the Early Dynastic period (to c. 2900 BCE). `latest: null` reflects that this research batch verified the origin and decipherment history, not the script's end-of-use date (commonly cited as a 1st-century-CE astronomical almanac); that endpoint was not independently re-verified this session and should not be read as "still in active use" — flagged for a dedicated follow-up pass. See claim_cuneiform_origin_type and claim_cuneiform_decipherment_status.
